主要内容: On June 8, 2012, Paul J. Sarvadi, Chairman of the Board and Chief Executive Officer of Insperity, Inc., established a new structured, prearranged trading plan to sell a portion of his Insperity common shares and exercise options over a six-month period in accordance with Rule 10b5-1 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The plan allows for the sale of up to 128,591 shares, including 34,091 shares from stock options, at predetermined prices ranging from $25 to $39. These shares represent approximately 7% of Mr. Sarvadi’s current holdings. The plan was initiated during the company’s open window for insider transactions, enabling regular, non-discretionary trading under Rule 10b5-1, which permits trading at times when insiders are not in possession of material nonpublic information.
